source.title: UMB World Rules of Carom Billiard (three cushions)

target.cite: UMB Art 29.1 (the distance is determined by the committee; 15 is the shipped spec-012 default)

two_cue_balls.cite: UMB Art 22.1 (two white balls, one spot/yellow) / 23.2 (the starter plays the plain white) / 23.4 (each player keeps the same ball for the entirety of the match) / 41.11 (not playing with his ball is a foul, indicated 'wrong ball')

insufficient_cushions_foul.cite: UMB Art 83 (fewer than three cushion contacts before the second object ball: 'there will be a foul', indicated by 'no cushion' or 'one cushion' or 'two cushions')

equal_innings.cite: UMB Art 29.3 (the committee determines whether matches are played with or without an even number of innings — the without regime; owner order GH-383: default OFF)

second_ball_visual.cite: UMB Art 22.1 ('the spot or yellow ball' — both markings are rulebook-sanctioned; worldwide practice is yellow, the letter also admits a dot-marked white; render default pending the GH-383 owner pick)

respot_incoming_striker.cite: UMB Art 27.3(b) ('the white ball of the player who wants to play' takes the central spot of the starting line — the INCOMING striker after the turn passed; audit-carom F5)

not_modeled.reason: the lag for the choice to begin is a physical pre-match ceremony; initialState(breaker) takes the winner as input (all five 011/012 rulesets share this simplification)
balls-in-motion / leather-tip / touched / pushed-through / frozen-cushion / foot-on-floor / marking / time fouls are physical-world referee judgments not detectable from the ShotRecord event stream
